reviews.title: Downgrade to old p12
reviews.comment:
These are honestly such a downgrade from the old p12s they push no air at all, they looked promising on paper and reviews. I tested them and literally got worse temps at the same rpm and similar sound profile. I’d stay away or get the old p12
Now that the p12 max are out of stock everywhere the best alternative to these is just the normal older p12 with fluid bearing
reviews.author: Clement Amiri
